fields.title: Caudan Food Festival
fields.short_description: A food festival along Caudan harbour
fields.description:
An evening on Caudan harbour — festival menus in the waterfront
restaurants, live music along the quay, boats and city lights behind you.
Somewhere you sit down and stay.

Organised by Caudan, so the dates change each year. The price shown is the
entry fee.
fields.pickup_details: No pickup - meet on site. Paid parking at Caudan.
fields.inclusions:
Entry to the festival at Caudan Waterfront
Live music and entertainment through the day
Access to all participating stalls and restaurants
Family activities
Not included: food and drink, paid at each stall
Not included: guide
Not included: transport and parking
fields.itinerary_text:
18:00 - Doors open, stalls and restaurant terraces start serving
19:00 - Snacks and street sweets along the quay -  candy floss, dholl puri
20:00 - Live show on the main stage, harbour lights come on
21:30 - Sega and dance on the waterfront
23:00 - Last orders, music until close
00:00 - Close
